# Character Creation (Point Buy)

This page tracks the character creation process using the Point Buy system (Sixth World Companion).

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
# Initial stats
Firewall = 0
Data_Processing = 0
Sleaze = 0
Attack = 0
Willpower = 0
Logic = 0
Intuition = 0
Charisma = 0
Resonance = 0
Edge = 0

Tasking = 0
Electronics = 0
Cracking = 0
Influence = 0
Con = 0

Karma = 0
Nuyen = 0
Contact_Points = 0
Character_Points = 0

def inc(name, amount=1):
    globals()[name] += amount
    op = "+=" if amount >= 0 else "-="
    return f"{name} {op} {abs(amount)}"

def assign(name, value):
    globals()[name] = value
    return f"{name} = {value}"

def inc_many(*pairs):
    res = []
    for name, amount in pairs:
        globals()[name] += amount
        op = "+=" if amount >= 0 else "-="
        res.append(f"{name} {op} {abs(amount)}")
    return ", ".join(res)
```

Shadowrunners are built with 100 Character Points (CP). You still gain 50 points of customization Karma.

* `{python} assign('Character_Points', 100)`
* `{python} assign('Karma', 50)`

## Choose Your Metatype/Metavariant

* Choose metatype: **AI / Pilot AI** `{python} inc('Karma', 0)`

## Choose Mundane, Awakened, or Emerged

* Emerged (Technomancer): `{python} inc('Character_Points', -10)`
* Technomancers start with `{python} assign('Resonance', 1)`.
  * Technomancers may purchase a number of complex forms up to their final Resonance x2.
  * These cost either 2 CP or 5 Karma each.
  * Technoregeneration: `{python} inc('Karma', -5)`
  * Cleaner: `{python} inc('Karma', -5)`
* Submersion - New Sprite Types: `{python} inc('Karma', -11)`
* Submersion - Sprite Conduit: `{python} inc('Karma', -12)`

## Purchase Special / Metatype Adjustment Points with CP

* All characters start with 1 Edge: `{python} inc('Edge', 1)`
* All characters start with 1 metatype adjustment point for free: `{python} inc('Resonance', 1)`
* You may purchase up to 12 additional adjustment points at 4 CP each:
  * `{python} inc('Resonance', 4)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -16)`
  * `{python} inc('Edge', 3)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -12)`

## Purchase Attributes with CP

* Digital Intelligence characters replace physical attributes with Matrix attributes (Firewall, Data Processing, Sleaze, Attack). All attributes start at minimum 1:
  * `{python} assign('Firewall', 1)` (Body equivalent)
  * `{python} assign('Data_Processing', 1)` (Agility equivalent)
  * `{python} assign('Sleaze', 1)` (Reaction equivalent)
  * `{python} assign('Attack', 1)` (Strength equivalent)
  * `{python} assign('Willpower', 1)`
  * `{python} assign('Logic', 1)`
  * `{python} assign('Intuition', 1)`
  * `{python} assign('Charisma', 1)`
* All characters start with 4 attribute points:
  * `{python} inc('Willpower', 4)`
* You may purchase up to 20 additional attribute points for 2 CP each:
  * `{python} inc('Willpower', 1)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -2)`
  * `{python} inc('Logic', 3)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -6)`
  * `{python} inc('Intuition', 1)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -2)`
  * `{python} inc('Charisma', 3)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -6)`
  * `{python} inc('Firewall', 4)` (Body equivalent) : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -8)`
  * `{python} inc('Sleaze', 4)` (Reaction equivalent) : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -8)`
  * `{python} inc('Data_Processing', 2)` (Agility equivalent) : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -4)`
  * `{python} inc('Attack', 2)` (Strength equivalent) : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -4)`


## Purchase Skills with CP

* All characters start with 12 skill points:
  * `{python} inc('Tasking', 6)`
  * `{python} inc('Electronics', 5)` 
  * `{python} inc('Cracking', 1)`
* You may purchase additional skill points for 2 CP each:
  * `{python} inc('Cracking', 4)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -8)`
  * `{python} inc('Influence', 1)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -2)`
  * `{python} inc('Con', 1)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -2)`
  * Cracking specialization - Hacking : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -2)`
  * Electronics specialization - Software : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -2)`
  * Tasking specialization - Registering : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -2)`
  
## Purchase Resources with CP

* All characters start with `{python} assign('Nuyen', 10000)`
* You may purchase resources at a rate of 1 CP per 20,000 Nuyen
  * `{python} inc_many(('Nuyen', 80000), ('Character_Points', -4))`

* `{python} inc_many(('Contact_Points', 6 * Charisma))`
